theorem_statements.name: Solidity.Yul.Compilation.ScopedControlCompilation.scope_selected
theorem_statements.signature:
theorem scope_selected (entry exit : Backend.Program) (body : Backend.Block) (code : List Evm.Instr)
 (selected : WordControl.blockCode (.seq (.code entry) (.seq body (.code exit))) = some code) :
 ∃ begin middle finish, WordMachine.selectCode entry = some begin ∧
 WordControl.blockCode body = some middle ∧ WordMachine.selectCode exit = some finish ∧
 code = begin ++ (middle ++ finish)

theorem_statements.name: Solidity.Yul.Compilation.ScopedControlCompletion.source_zero
theorem_statements.signature:
theorem source_zero {c : Control} {n fresh : Nat} {body : Stmt [] [] c (fresh+n)}
 (profile : StmtWordP body) (horizon : Nat)
 (locals : Vector Scalar.Word n) (out : Vector Scalar.Word (fresh+n))
 (ran : evalStmt horizon .nil True.intro body profile
   (sourceLocals (Vector.replicate fresh (0 : Scalar.Word) ++ locals)) = some ⟨sourceLocals out,.normal⟩) :
 evalStmt (horizon+1) .nil True.intro (.zero fresh body) profile (sourceLocals locals) =
 some ⟨sourceLocals (outerLocals out),.normal⟩
